lena: proposed flow (short):
1) Owner outreach 4 business days for all flagged principals. message template posted to SEC-8342.
2) For high-risk cross-project binds: open vendor coordination tickets and schedule joint maintenance; do not disable keys until partner confirms.
3) For medium-risk (active recently): staged staging disable (48h) + smoke tests, keep KMS grants during initial canary.
4) For low-risk (no activity >1y): immediate suspend + rotate keys if any, then remove admin role.
5) Post-prune audit 7d and update recert board.
